_comment: Generated by scripts/build_patch_data.py from the cached EA page in data/patch-source/. 'text' is EA's exact wording and must stay that way - scripts/build_patch_data.py --check re-reads EA's page and fails if any bullet is missing or altered. 'section' and 'items' are meant to be hand-corrected and are not overwritten by --check.

entries.text: At 8:00 UTC , the update becomes available to download across all platforms, bringing the latest gameplay changes to Battlefield 6.
At 12:00 UTC , Season 4: Tidal Strike content goes live, including the Deep Six Collection Event, the Phantom Program, and Proximity Chat.
Below the Commo Rose, you can now quickly swap channels and globally turn Proximity Chat on or off.
heading: NEW CONTENT
Proximity Chat

entries.text: Opening the scoreboard in Battle Royale will show a list of recent players you’ve heard through Proximity Chat. From there, you can mute, report, or block a player by selecting their name through the EA Connect pop-up.
heading: NEW CONTENT
Proximity Chat

entries.text: Up to four players can be heard at the same time. A UI message will let you know when this limit has been reached, with additional speakers temporarily muted until a channel becomes available.
heading: NEW CONTENT
Proximity Chat
